scripts.deploy: gcloud run deploy ninja-generator --source . --project ninja-497502 --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --port 3000
scripts.deploy:env: gcloud run services update ninja-generator --project ninja-497502 --region us-central1 --update-env-vars "BODY_SIZE_LIMIT=10M,$(grep -E '^(MESHY_API_KEY|TRIPO_API_KEY|GEMINI_API_KEY|OPENAI_API_KEY|IMAGE_ENGINE)=' .env | paste -sd, -)"
